scientific_integrity: The universal proof is elementary and self-contained. Its literature comparisons are best-knowledge, not an independent priority certification; possible unindexed equivalences remain.
scientific_limitations: Binary linear words with fixed counts of zeros and ones and exact runs; the counted pattern is scattered 010 (and binary-complement 101). Longer patterns and unrestricted alphabets are outside the theorem. Finite checks verify examples and are not the universal proof.
title: Sharp cubic run penalties for scattered alternating triples in binary words
